newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE ON ROADSHOW TO U.S. OCT 22-23.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE ON ROADSHOW TO U.S. OCT 22-23.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange will present Greece's equity market to U.S. institutional investors in New York and Boston on October 22 and 23.

The presentations will include contacts with representatives of the Greek-American community aiming to provide Greeks in the U.S. with a well-rounded view of the Athens bourse, the Athens stock exchange said in a statement.
Joining bourse president Manolis Xanthakis will be capital markets commission president Stavros Thomadakis, the deputy governor of the Bank of Greece and executives of the following listed firms:
Alpha Credit Bank, Ergo Bank, National Bank, OTE telecom, Titan Cements, Viohalko, Delta Dairy, Goody's, Aegek, Attica Enterprises and 3E Hellenic Bottling.
